stemMarkdown: If 12 men can build a wall in 12 days, how many days will 24 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $12 \times 12 = 144$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 24 men that is $\dfrac{144}{24} = 6.0$ days.
